report_text: Payments API is throwing 500s for about 10% of checkout requests since roughly 20 minutes ago. Customers are seeing failed orders. I've already rolled back last night's deploy as a first step but errors are still coming in intermittently. Escalating to on-call now.
hey team, noticed the internal wiki has been super slow to load pages since this morning. not customer facing, just annoying for us. haven't done anything about it yet, figured i'd flag it here first

A customer flagged that our password reset emails stopped arriving overnight. Checked the email-gateway logs and confirmed delivery failures starting around 2am. No customer data was exposed, this is purely a delivery issue. Notified our email vendor already and waiting to hear back.

URGENT - we think someone may have gained unauthorized access to the customer database. Found unusual query patterns in the logs from the last hour. Have NOT touched anything yet, waiting for security team guidance before we do anything that might destroy evidence. This needs eyes on it immediately.
FYI the CI/CD pipeline failed on the last 3 builds in a row, seems like a flaky test rather than anything serious. Will look into it tomorrow, not blocking anyone right now.
